title: Feedback:Game updates/20260722
wikitext:
== Update July 22, 2026 ==

Here are the results of our device testing as performed by an external organization.  Comparing your device to the age and/or capabilities of one of these devices will give you an idea of how the game will perform on your mobile device.

=== iOS devices ===

{| class="wikitable sortable"
|+ iOS device performance results
! Device !! OS version !! FPS range !! Average FPS !! Performance result !! Observation
|-
| iPhone 16 || iOS 26.4 || 49–61 FPS || 59 FPS || Smooth || The FPS drops to 49 only when multiple henchmen use their skills simultaneously.
|-
| iPhone 15 || iOS 26.4 || 46–61 FPS || 59 FPS || Smooth || The FPS drops during the transition from the Old Ascalon explorable area to The Breach.
|-
| iPhone 14 || iOS 26.4 || 45–61 FPS || 60 FPS || Smooth || The game runs smoothly; it only experiences an FPS drop to 45 when another mob gets close right after eliminating one.
|-
| iPhone 13 || iOS 26.4 || 16–61 FPS || 48 FPS || Fair || The game runs well on this device, but it consistently experiences FPS drops during battles.
|-
| iPhone SE || iOS 26.4 || 18–61 FPS || 45 FPS || Fair || The game experiences significant FPS drops, running at around 20–30 FPS in The Breach during battles with the Charr.
|}

=== Android devices ===

{| class="wikitable sortable"
|+ Android device performance results
! Device !! OS version !! FPS range !! Average FPS !! Performance result !! Observation
|-
| Samsung Galaxy A55 5G || Android 15 || 48–72 FPS || 58 FPS || Smooth || The game runs smoothly with no noticeable drops in FPS.
|-
| Samsung Galaxy A36 5G || Android 15 || 23–76 FPS || 52 FPS || Smooth || Frame drops are felt only once or twice and do not really affect gameplay. The drops are not severe either — the frame rate stays around 52 FPS and can reach 76 FPS at times, especially in less crowded areas of the map.
|-
| Samsung Galaxy A34 5G || Android 15 || 21–81 FPS || 55 FPS || Smooth || The gameplay is smooth, and while drops can happen during battle, they are not really noticeable.
|-
| Samsung Galaxy A32 5G || Android 13 || 37–61 FPS || 51 FPS || Smooth || The game is smooth on this device, with no severe frame drops experienced.
|-
| Samsung Galaxy S9+ || Android 10 || 7–60 FPS || 45 FPS || Fair || Frame drops can sometimes be felt, especially in crowded areas of the map, where the frame rate can fall as low as 7 FPS.
|-
| Samsung Galaxy S7 || Android 8 || 7–30 FPS || 18 FPS || Lag || The lag is consistent, and the frame rate drops severely in crowded areas of the map and during battles.
|-
| Samsung Galaxy A13 || Android 13 || 5–27 FPS || 18 FPS || Lag || Gameplay on this device feels stuttery and the FPS is inconsistent, making the experience worse than on other devices.
|-
| Samsung Galaxy A50s || Android 10 || 7–33 FPS || 18 FPS || Lag || The game experiences consistent lag throughout the session, which significantly impacts performance and disrupts the overall flow of gameplay.
|}
